data.title: GCL Global Withdraws Proposals Ahead of December 1 EGM
data.description:
GCL Global Holdings ( (GCL) ) has issued an update.

GCL Global Holdings Ltd announced on November 27, 2026, that its board had withdrawn all proposals for the reconvened extraordinary general meeting scheduled for December 1, 2026. The decision followed written confirmation received on November 23 that the company had regained compliance with Nasdaq’s US$1.00 minimum bid-price requirement under Listing Rule 5550(a)(2).

The meeting was still scheduled to convene, but the proposals would not be presented, considered or voted on, and previously submitted voting instructions or proxies for them would have no voting effect. Validly appointed proxies would continue to be counted in determining whether a quorum was present.

data.title: PetMed Express Implements Tax Benefit Preservation Rights Plan
data.description:
The latest announcement is out from Petmed Express ( (PETS) ).

On November 24, 2026, PetMed Express’ board authorized a dividend of rights tied to its common stock and adopted Articles of Amendment establishing the rights of a new Series B participating preferred stock. On November 25, the company adopted a Tax Benefit Preservation Plan, under which one right was designated for each common share held on the December 7 record date, with a $7 exercise price.

On November 27, the company said the plan was effective immediately and ended its prior limited-duration rights plan by moving expiration from December 2 to 12:01 a.m. that day; all prior rights then expired without payment. The new plan was intended to reduce the risk that an ownership change under Section 382 would limit PetMeds’ estimated $43.4 million in federal net operating loss carryforwards, with unauthorized ownership of 4.9% or more potentially triggering dilution; rights expire no later than November 25, 2029, unless ended earlier under the plan.

data.title: QHSLab Reports Nine-Month 2026 Financial Results Amid Losses
data.description:
An update from QHSLab ( (USAQ) ) is now available.

On November 27, 2026, QHSLab reported unaudited financial results for the nine months ended September 30, 2026. Total revenue increased 13.4% to $2,253,347, ISP revenue rose 63.9% to $1,287,692, gross margin improved to 67.9%, and interest expense decreased 90.0%; net loss totaled $119,021 versus $99,156.

ISP revenue represented approximately 57% of total revenue, while combined allergy diagnostic kit and immunotherapy revenue decreased 19.3%, and third-quarter total revenue fell 8.1%. Operating expenses increased 32.7%, cash declined by $445,693, and total liabilities decreased 54.7%; the Company said substantial doubt remained regarding its ability to continue as a going concern without sustainable positive operating cash flow or additional financing.

data.title: Navitas Semiconductor Acquires Patents in $10 Million Agreement
data.description:
An update from Navitas Semiconductor ( (NVTS) ) is now available.

On November 20, 2026, Navitas Semiconductor USA, Inc., an indirect subsidiary of Navitas Semiconductor Corporation, agreed to acquire certain patents and patent applications from Longitude Flash Memory Solutions Limited and Longitude Licensing Limited, two Irish private companies. The transaction also terminated certain intercompany licenses and agreements relating to the assigned patents.

It also agreed to pay 1.5% of gross licensing and other revenues from monetizing the patents, including the fair market value of non-cash consideration.

data.title: Tiziana Files FDA Safety Update Reporting No Serious Drug-Related Events for Intranasal Foralumab
data.description:
Tiziana Life Sciences ( (TLSA) ) has shared an announcement.

Tiziana Life Sciences is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing immunomodulation therapies through alternative drug-delivery technologies. Its lead candidate, intranasal foralumab, is a fully human anti-CD3 monoclonal antibody being studied in neuroinflammatory and neurodegenerative diseases, including non-active secondary progressive multiple sclerosis, Alzheimer’s disease, multiple system atrophy and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.

On November 27, 2026, the company announced submitting an annual Development Safety Update Report to the FDA covering September 2, 2024, through September 30, 2026. The report found no drug-related serious adverse events across 48.1 patient-years of cumulative exposure, while the release said safety and tolerability remained favorable, no new risks led to significant protocol amendments, and the benefit-risk profile remained favorable across the clinical programs.

data.title: FinVolution Group Reports Third-Quarter 2026 Results; Overseas Revenue Rises
data.description:
An update from FinVolution Group ( (FINV) ) is now available.

FinVolution Group, a fintech platform facilitating loan transactions across China and overseas markets, announced on November 25, 2026, unaudited results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. In mainland China, transaction volume fell 66.8% year over year to RMB15.8 billion and outstanding loan balance fell 37.6% to RMB46.7 billion, while the 90-day-plus delinquency ratio was 2.50%.

Overseas transaction volume rose 11.1% to RMB4.0 billion, revenue increased 10.9% to RMB948.9 million and operating profit rose from RMB28.7 million to RMB62.1 million; overseas revenue represented 37.1% of total revenue. Group revenue was RMB2,557.9 million and net profit was RMB205.6 million, down from RMB3,486.6 million and RMB640.7 million, respectively, in the same period of 2025.

data.title: Columbia Financial Appoints Interim CFO as Search Begins
data.description:
An update from Columbia Financial ( (CLBK) ) is now available.

On November 20, 2026, Thomas Splaine, Jr., Columbia Financial and Columbia Bank’s executive vice president and chief financial officer, notified both organizations of his intent to resign effective December 18, 2026, for personal reasons. The company said his employment resignation did not result from any disagreement about its financial statements, operations, policies or practices.

On November 23, 2026, the boards appointed Dennis E. Gibney as interim chief financial officer effective December 18, 2026. Gibney previously held the CFO role from 2014 through January 28, 2026, will retain his current position during the interim period, and the company has engaged an executive search firm to find a permanent CFO.
